title: Apprentice Software Developer

about.duties:
Join an established company with an enviable reputation for supplying a market leading business systems solution into builders/timbers/plumbing merchants. Your role will be to assist on a variety of projects including development of new functionality as well as maintain existing systems. You will be exposed to a broad range of technologies and the full product development lifecycle.

This a very exciting time to join us as we move from a traditional server application to a cloud-based solution. You will report to a senior developer who will provide the mentoring and support to help develop your career in software development. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a well-established business that believes in working hard and having fun at the same time.

Responsibilities include (with training and full support): Developing applications, managing support requests, bug tracing and fixing, managing personal tasks unaided when required, monitoring scheduled processes, and maintaining a relaxed but professional relationship with colleagues.

apply.additionalInstructions: This role is not suitable for candidates with an existing IT degree. Border Merchant Systems is part of the Hermitage Innovation Group – a successful business that’s been in existence for 38 years. Border focuses on builders/timber and plumbing merchants and we’re proud that we’re a place where people want to come and work with us and feel motivated and challenged everyday. We also like eating bacon sandwiches and cake!

interview: If shortlisted you will be contacted by our Apprenticeship specialists, Salad Skills, by phone. If  successful you will be invited to a friendly group assessment session at Borders, with a max of 8 candidates. If unsuccessful after this stage you will receive personalised feedback with your strengths and tips to improve your chances at future interviews/assessments.
